stories.title: Sébastien Lecornu rabote son budget 2027 et met les forces politiques sous pression

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu cuts his 2027 budget and puts political forces under pressure
en.summary: The prime minister is requesting the government reduce spending in 2027 to match 2026 levels exactly. He is signaling to lawmakers that resolving the Lyhanna matter depends on passing the finance law.

stories.title: Mort de Catherine Ringer : "Elle avait fait de sa voix un théâtre et de chaque chanson une liberté", lui rend hommage Emmanuel Macron

en.title: Death of Catherine Ringer: "She turned her voice into theatre and every song into freedom," Emmanuel Macron pays tribute
en.summary: French singer Catherine Ringer died from aggressive cancer on the night of September 14, 2026, her children announced. President Macron commemorated her artistic legacy and the freedom her music represented.

stories.title: Drone abattu en Lituanie, fusées tirées au Danemark : l'UE dénonce des "provocations" russes

en.title: Drone shot down in Lithuania, rockets fired at Denmark: EU denounces Russian "provocations"
en.summary: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen condemned Russia's conduct after the Danemark reported flare rockets fired at one of its helicopters and NATO aircraft downed a drone over Lithuania.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : pour Sébastien Lecornu, le danger d’un RN en fourbe-fête

en.title: 2027 Budget: for Sébastien Lecornu, the danger of a tricky National Rally
en.summary: Marine Le Pen wants an imperfect but operational budget before elections, while the possibility of the National Rally not blocking it emerges. The government faces a difficult situation while maintaining it will not negotiate with the far-right.

stories.title: Mort de Catherine Ringer : on veut pas l’abandonner

en.title: Death of Catherine Ringer: we don't want to abandon her
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, half of punk rock group Les Rita Mitsouko, died at age 68. Known for her fierce personality and outspoken nature, she passed away 19 years after bandmate Fred Chichin.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Lecornu propose 1,5 milliard d'euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles

en.title: 2027 Budget: Lecornu proposes 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence
en.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced budget allocations for comprehensive legislation against gender-based and sexual violence to be debated in Parliament in autumn 2026, including 1.5 billion euros for this cause and 2.6 billion for child protection.

stories.title: Mort de Catherine Ringer, des moyens pour la protection de l’enfance, drone abattu par l’Otan en Lituanie… L’actu de ce mardi 15 septembre

en.title: Death of Catherine Ringer, funding for child protection, NATO drone shot down in Lithuania... Today's news on Tuesday, September 15
en.summary: A news roundup covering major events of the day including a notable death, child welfare developments, and a military incident in the Baltic region.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu ne veut pas augmenter les dépenses de l’Etat, excepté pour la défense

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu does not want to increase state spending, except for defense
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlined a budget strategy aimed at reassuring financial markets and political opponents by constraining overall government expenditure while protecting defense allocations.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu promet 1,5 milliard d'euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles, ainsi que 2,6 milliards pour la protection de l'enfance

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu pledges 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence, and 2.6 billion for child protection
en.summary: The Prime Minister announced financial targets for comprehensive legislation against gender-based and sexual violence, allocating 1.5 billion euros to this effort and 2.6 billion euros for child protection measures.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu demande à ses ministres que les dépenses de l'Etat restent "strictement au même niveau" qu'en 2026

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu asks his ministers to keep state spending "strictly at the same level" as 2026
en.summary: France's Prime Minister has instructed government members to maintain state expenditures at 2026 levels while identifying additional cost-saving measures for the 2027 budget.

stories.title: "Une chanteuse exceptionnelle", "un amour de la liberté", "une reine"... Les réactions après l'annonce de la mort de Catherine Ringer

en.title: "An exceptional singer", "a love of freedom", "a queen"... Reactions following the announcement of Catherine Ringer's death
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, the vocalist from Rita Mitsouko, died Monday evening at age 68 from a rapid cancer, with her passing occurring 19 years after guitarist Fred Chichin's death.

stories.title: Mort de Catherine Ringer : cinq titres cultes de l'une des icônes de la chanson française

en.title: Death of Catherine Ringer: five iconic songs from one of the icons of French music
en.summary: Catherine Ringer possessed a powerful voice and distinctive style that significantly influenced French popular music throughout her career.

stories.title: Face au décrochage industriel, Ursula von der Leyen doit rassurer sur « l'indépendance » de l'Europe

en.title: Facing industrial decline, Ursula von der Leyen must reassure on Europe's "independence"
en.summary: The European Commission president will deliver a State of the Union address to lawmakers covering defense, Ukraine, industry, energy, AI, and the EU budget. Specific policy measures are expected to be announced.

stories.title: Strasbourg face à Bruxelles : la bras de fer sur le « made in Europe » industriel

en.title: Strasbourg versus Brussels: the arm-wrestling over industrial 'made in Europe'
en.summary: The European Parliament and the Commission are in conflict over the future of European industry, with Parliament pushing for a more aggressive version of the Industrial Accelerator Act than the Commission's proposal.

stories.title: Croissance : la Banque de France insiste sur la « résilience » de l'économie française

en.title: Growth: Banque de France emphasizes 'resilience' of French economy
en.summary: Banque de France projects 0.4% economic growth this year and highlights the French economy's ability to withstand headwinds, contrasting with INSEE's assessment.

stories.title: Air Corsica, Air Caraïbes et French Bee jouent l'alliance depuis Orly

en.title: Air Corsica, Air Caraïbes and French Bee form alliance from Orly
en.summary: Air Corsica signed a code-sharing agreement with Air Caraïbes and French Bee to expand its international network and reach North American passengers.

stories.title: À Steenvoorde, Danone inaugure sa « plus grande ligne de nutrition médicale en France »

en.title: At Steenvoorde, Danone inaugurates its 'largest medical nutrition line in France'
en.summary: Danone opened a new production facility in Steenvoorde capable of producing 20 million liters of oral nutritional supplements annually for oncology, geriatric, and post-hospitalization patients.
